scripts.build: npm run build -w @tabliodb/shared && npm run build -w @tabliodb/schema-core && npm run build -w @tabliodb/sql && npm run build -w @tabliodb/docs && npm run build -w @tabliodb/render && npm run build -w @tabliodb/ui && npm run build -w @tabliodb/sdk && npm run build -w @tabliodb/server && npm run build -w @tabliodb/web
scripts.docker:prod:logs: docker compose --env-file docker/production.env -f docker/docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f tabliodb
scripts.sdk:generate: npm run openapi:sync && oazapfts --optimistic --argumentStyle=object --useEnumType --allSchemas open-api/tabliodb-openapi-specs.json packages/sdk/src/fetch-client.ts && prettier --write packages/sdk/src/fetch-client.ts
